I See You is a 2006 Indian Hindi-language romantic comedy film directed by Vivek Agrawal and produced by Mehr Jesia. The film stars Arjun Rampal and Vipasha Agarwal. Chunky Pandey, Sonali Kulkarni, Sophie Chaudhary, Boman Irani and Kirron Kher are featured in supporting roles. The film was released on 29 December 2006. It was filmed in London. The film is based on the novel If Only It Were True by Marc Levy. It also has elements from the Malayalam film Vismayathumbathu, and from the 2005 American film Just Like Heaven, which were both also based on the same novel.
